title: Yara and the Letters
author: Casper Dunmore
blurb: Sable Hartwell, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent ten years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
